Is that massive mountain range obstructing the grand vision of your next industrial mega-base? It is time to reshape the very topography of the world. By fusing the Destruction Catalyst and the Hyperkinetic Lens together using an exorbitant, almost reckless amount of Dark Matter, you have forged the absolute apex of alchemical terraforming. The Catalytic Lens doesn't just mine; it completely annihilates geography on a catastrophic scale. You are going to absolutely love the sheer, unbridled power it puts at your fingertips.

Functionally, this lens combines the piercing power and wide-area destruction of its predecessors and amplifies them to an absurd degree. With a single click, you can flatten entire landscapes, instantly clearing vast swaths of land to make room for your sprawling GregTech machine halls.

Absolutely, under no circumstances, should you ever attempt to use, test, or even casually hold this artifact while inside your factory. A single misclick will vaporize your AE2 network, your multiblocks, and hundreds of hours of hard work. You have been warned!
